_readme: Step 2B benchmark extension. These queries are ADDED to the 21 seed queries in evals/retrieval.json (left untouched). kind: retrieval = at least one real document is relevant; negative = nothing in the corpus is a suitable answer, so an empty result is correct; missing_knowledge = a legitimate question whose answer SHOULD exist but the collection holds no such document (reported as a corpus gap, excluded from quality metrics). expect = relevant document ids (all must be found for full recall). equivalent = interchangeable substitutes, e.g. the same recipe implemented by another renderer. filter = RetrieveFilter passed to the retriever (shot_recipes default to include_draft:true because every recipe is draft today). Every id in expect/equivalent must exist in the corpus; the runner fails otherwise.

queries.query: what is the 180 degree rule
queries.why: Document is titled 'The 180-degree rule'.

queries.query: keeping left and right consistent between two shots of the same action
queries.why: Describes the screen-direction continuity the rule protects, without naming the rule.

queries.why: The Murch note ranks cut goals and says to serve the higher one.

queries.query: hide the edit inside a movement so the cut feels smooth
queries.why: Cut-on-motion note: a cut hidden inside a movement feels smoother.

queries.query: keep captions inside the safe area and easy to read
queries.why: Text-legibility note covers line length, hold time and safe area.

queries.why: Note says two adjacent shots of nearly the same size look like a mistake.

queries.query: tight crop on the label texture of the product

queries.query: energetic reveal of the new feature with impact

queries.query: calm closing scene where the logo appears and viewers read the call to action

queries.query: energetic change between scenes
queries.why: directional-wipe is the only high-energy transition.

queries.query: zoom

queries.query: big figure result

queries.query: slow zoom in

queries.query: slow zoom in

queries.query: what matters most when choosing where to cut: feeling, story or timing
